rationale: Price has been completely frozen at $13.62 for the last five 1-minute candles with volume collapsing from 10,390 to 3,713 — this is a stalled tape with no directional momentum to exploit. At 90% of today's range with only 42 minutes to close and the stock already near its session high, the risk/reward for a long is poor (only $0.09 to the high vs. meaningful downside), while a short against a strong uptrend with price pinned at the 9-EMA offers no clear catalyst. The combination of price compression, diminishing volume, and proximity to forced liquidation at close makes this an unfavorable entry in either direction.
